import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import torchvision.models as models
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
from torchvision.models import resnet18, ResNet18_Weights
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os
from PIL import Image
import warnings
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)
torch.manual_seed(42)
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(42)

# Device configuration
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

# Paths
input_dir = Path("./input")
images_dir = input_dir / "images"
train_df = pd.read_csv(input_dir / "train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(input_dir / "test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(input_dir / "sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train samples: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_sub.columns.tolist()}")

# Target columns - matches sample_submission format
target_cols = ["healthy", "multiple_diseases", "rust", "scab"]

# Split validation - hold out 20% from training data
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df.index,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df[target_cols].values,
)

train_df_valid = train_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_df = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df_valid)}")
print(f"Validation samples: {len(val_df)}")

# Image transformation for training (with augmentation)
train_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomRotation(30),
        transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.3, contrast=0.3, saturation=0.3, hue=0.1),
        transforms.RandomAffine(degrees=0, translate=(0.1, 0.1)),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


# Image class for dataset
class ImageDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, images_dir, transform=None):
        self.df = df
        self.images_dir = Path(images_dir)
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        image_id = self.df.iloc[idx]["image_id"]
        image_path = self.images_dir / f"{image_id}.jpg"
        image = Image.open(image_path).convert("RGB")

        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)

        targets = self.df.iloc[idx][target_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
        return image, targets


# Create datasets
train_dataset = ImageDataset(train_df_valid, images_dir, transform=train_transform)
val_dataset = ImageDataset(val_df, images_dir, transform=train_transform)

# Create dataloaders
train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=True, num_workers=2)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=False, num_workers=2)


# Define model - ResNet18 pretrained
def create_model(num_classes=4):
    model = resnet18(weights=ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)

    # Freeze early layers
    for param in list(model.parameters())[:100]:
        param.requires_grad = False

    # Replace final layer
    num_features = model.fc.in_features
    model.fc = nn.Sequential(nn.Dropout(0.2), nn.Linear(num_features, num_classes))

    return model


model = create_model(num_classes=len(target_cols))
model = model.to(device)
print(f"Model parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")

# Training configuration
criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
    filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, model.parameters()), lr=0.001, weight_decay=1e-4
)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=40)

# Training loop with early stopping
num_epochs = 40
best_val_auc = 0
best_model_state = None
patience_counter = 0
patience = 10

print("\nStarting training...")
start_time = time.time()

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0

    for images, targets in train_loader:
        images = images.to(device)
        targets = torch.tensor(targets, dtype=torch.float32).to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(images)
        loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

        train_loss += loss.item()

    scheduler.step()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_preds_all = []
    val_targets_all = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, targets in val_loader:
            images = images.to(device)
            outputs = model(images)
            val_preds_all.append(torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu())
            val_targets_all.append(targets)

    val_preds_all = torch.cat(val_preds_all, dim=0).numpy()
    val_targets_all = torch.cat(val_targets_all, dim=0).numpy()

    # Compute ROC AUC per column
    val_auc_scores = []
    for i in range(len(target_cols)):
        try:
            auc = roc_auc_score(val_targets_all[:, i], val_preds_all[:, i])
            val_auc_scores.append(auc)
        except Exception as e:
            val_auc_scores.append(0.5)

    val_auc = np.mean(val_auc_scores)
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs}, Val AUC: {val_auc:.4f}, Time: {elapsed:.1f}s")

    if val_auc > best_val_auc:
        best_val_auc = val_auc
        best_model_state = model.state_dict().copy()
        patience_counter = 0
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

    if elapsed > 5000:  # 5000s = ~83 minutes, safety check
        print(f"Time limit approaching at epoch {epoch+1}, stopping training")
        break

# Load best model
if best_model_state is not None:
    model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
else:
    print("No validation AUC improved, using last model state")

print(f"\nTraining complete. Best Val AUC: {best_val_auc:.4f}")
final_train_time = time.time() - start_time
print(f"Training time: {final_train_time:.1f}s")


# Function to get single prediction (no TTA for speed)
def get_prediction(image_path):
    model.eval()
    image = Image.open(image_path).convert("RGB")
    image_tensor = (
        transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )(image)
        .unsqueeze(0)
        .to(device)
    )

    with torch.no_grad():
        output = model(image_tensor)
        pred = torch.sigmoid(output).cpu().numpy()[0]

    return pred


# Final validation with single prediction on hold-out set
print("\nComputing final hold-out validation...")
val_preds_final = []
for idx in range(len(val_df)):
    image_id = val_df.iloc[idx]["image_id"]
    image_path = images_dir / f"{image_id}.jpg"
    pred = get_prediction(image_path)
    val_preds_final.append(pred)

val_preds_final = np.array(val_preds_final)

# Compute mean column-wise ROC AUC on hold-out set
final_val_auc_scores = []
for i in range(len(target_cols)):
    try:
        auc = roc_auc_score(val_df[target_cols[i]].values, val_preds_final[:, i])
        final_val_auc_scores.append(auc)
    except Exception as e:
        final_val_auc_scores.append(0.5)

final_holdout_auc = np.mean(final_val_auc_scores)
print(f"\nHold-out validation AUC (mean column-wise): {final_holdout_auc:.6f}")
print(f"Individual AUCs: {final_val_auc_scores}")


# Generate submission for test set (single prediction, no TTA)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame()
print("\nGenerating test submission...")
test_start = time.time()
for idx in range(len(test_df)):
    image_id = test_df.iloc[idx]["image_id"]
    test_image_path = images_dir / f"{image_id}.jpg"

    pred = get_prediction(test_image_path)

    submission_row = {"image_id": image_id}
    for col, prob in zip(target_cols, pred):
        submission_row[col] = float(prob)

    submission_df = pd.concat(
        [submission_df, pd.DataFrame([submission_row])], ignore_index=True
    )
    if (idx + 1) % 50 == 0:
        print(f"Processed {idx + 1}/{len(test_df)} test images")

test_time = time.time() - test_start
print(f"Test prediction time: {test_time:.1f}s")

# Ensure submission directory exists and save
submission_dir = Path("./submission")
submission_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(
    f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission_df)} rows"
)
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}, Submission rows: {len(submission_df)}")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission_df.columns.tolist()}")

# Final metrics
print(f"\n=== FINAL HOLD-OUT VALIDATION METRIC ===")
print(f"Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {final_holdout_auc:.6f}")
